gaps.sentence: Please fill ___ this form and sign at the bottom.
gaps.explanation: fill in/out a form (British prefers in).

gaps.sentence: He ___ up the word in an online dictionary.
gaps.explanation: 'Look a word up' = check its meaning.

gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).

gaps.sentence: It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
